hooks.command: [ -z "$PINGBUS_MEMBERSHIP" ] || [ -e "$PINGBUS_HOME/active" ] || { [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET" ] || (umask 077 && jq -n 'env | {v: 1, socket: .CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET, token: .CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN}' > "$PINGBUS_HOME/.socket.json.tmp" && mv -f "$PINGBUS_HOME/.socket.json.tmp" "$PINGBUS_HOME/socket.json") || exit 1; exit 0; }; exec pingbus hook session-start
[ -z "$PINGBUS_MEMBERSHIP" ] || [ -e "$PINGBUS_HOME/active" ] || exit 0; if [ "$PINGBUS_DELIVERY" = relay ]; then exec pingbus hook post-tool; fi
